items.title: Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: Remember anybody named Baptiste? ... Baptiste Delay, yeah. He used to play all his, uh... Yeah, yeah, yeah. All his halls around here.

ctx.x: George Fields was a good one, too. George Fields. Uh, I must say... Another boy, uh... Ackham used to play, too. Ackham. Ackham. Ackham. I saw his grave.
This other, what you call him, they're this, uh, Vig Gaspar? Oh, yeah, oh, Vig Gaspar. Vig Gaspar. Oh, yeah, yeah. Vig Gaspar. Yeah, yeah. Vig Gaspar. Remember anybody named Baptiste?
Oh, that, that... Baptiste. Baptiste, yeah, yeah, oh, man, that's some kind of... He was here. I don't remember Baptiste. Baptiste still is there?
